## kram-p03-v03 — argument map

Unscrutinized self never shares thing-knowing; unscrutinized, without grasping-course, it is not. But Śiva — that self shining, one sap of all things — hence I, heart-devoted, ever blissful in Your hymn.

### Open
- 'marśanavidhi elision kept; asau demonstrative force.
